title: ewa-extreme-world
label: The Model

won.source: the fed's own CAGED card: “The winner of this match, and New EWA World Champion The Model!!!”

how: Beat Commander D in the Hell in a Cell main event of CAGED; retained at Royal Demolitions on 10 May 2008 by taking the belt down from the ladder himself.

title: ewa-extreme-world
label: Commander D

won.source: No won date survives; the ring announcer bills him as the reigning EWA World Champion at CAGED, 12 April 2008.

how: Lost the belt to the Model in a Hell in a Cell main event at CAGED.
note: The start of this reign is not in the surviving record.

title: ewa-extreme-tag-team
label: X-Rated

won.source: the fed's own CAGED card: “The winners of this match, and new EWA World Tag champions, X-Rated!!!”

how: Won a four-team Hell in a Cell at CAGED for the belts the Chairman of the Board had stripped from the previous champions.
note: The stripped champions are not named on the card. The card's own action text never shows the Model or Red Steel wrestling this match by name -- it credits all of X-Rated's offense and the submission fall to Phoenix (unbilled on any of the four teams) over the Extreme Menace, and the ring announcer's credit to X-Rated stands as the fed's declared result regardless (see shows.json's own match note on ewa-extreme-caged-2008-04-12).

title: ewa-extreme-television
label: The Renagade

won.source: No won date survives; the ring announcer bills him with the EWA TV title belt from the first held card, 3 April 2008.

how: Defended against King on 3 April 2008 and against Xero on 21 April 2008.
note: The start of this reign is not in the surviving record.

title: ewa-extreme-north-american
label: Andy

won.source: No won date survives; the ring announcer bills him with the EWA North American title belt from the first held card, 3 April 2008.

how: Defended in a cage against the Renagade at CAGED and against “The Real Deal” Jimmy Steele at Royal Demolitions.
note: The start of this reign is not in the surviving record.

title: ewa-extreme-lightweight
label: The Extreme Menace

won.source: the fed's own Royal Demolitions card: “The winner of this match, and new EWA Lightweight champion, The Extreme Menace!!!”

how: Won a four-man Ultimate Ladder match at Royal Demolitions.

title: ewa-extreme-hardcore
label: Red Steel

won.source: the fed's own Royal Demolitions card: “The winner of this match, and new EWA Hardcore champion, Red Steel!!!”

how: Beat the Renagade and the Dark Angel in a Falls Count Anywhere Hardcore Brawl at Royal Demolitions.
